response: {"action":"sql","sql":"SELECT p.dept_cd, s.cntry_cd, SUM(ol.line_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_ln ol JOIN ord_hdr oh ON ol.ord_id = oh.ord_id JOIN prod_ref p ON ol.prod_id = p.prod_id JOIN store_dim s ON oh.store_id = s.store_id WHERE oh.sts_cd <> 'X' GROUP BY p.dept_cd, s.cntry_cd ORDER BY p.dept_cd, s.cntry_cd","reason":"Revenue computed from ord_ln.line_amt (product-level) joined to prod_ref for dept and store_dim for country, filtering cancelled orders per required_filter."}
